notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!

Hope you're enjoying the demo so far! All the feedback is very appreciated!

I've got some fixes here.

[list]
[*] Fixed issue with camera if player is killed while in lock-picking mini-game.
[*] Fixed issue with camera locking up upon exiting search mini-game.
[*] Adjusted volumes of assorted SFX
[/list]

Thanks for playing! Please feel free to report any problems you may find. Every bit of feedback is extremely helpful!

Have a Happy Halloween and a great Steam Next Fest!

Robert Maners
